comment: What each device description must select, recorded apart from the compiler and the descriptions: RP2040 from pico-sdk 2.2.0, the STM32H753 from ST's stm32h753xx.h and RM0433, the constrained reference from [1990]. descriptions.py compares every fact of each linked image with these.

sources.memory map: https://github.com/raspberrypi/pico-sdk/blob/2.2.0/src/rp2_common/pico_crt0/rp2040/memmap_default.ld, SHA-256 d409afb35ec0a8c3edf5ad6935907cb45f225a3cbdfd4c3b8505a7ed92df28dc: RAM 0x20000000 256k, SCRATCH_X 0x20040000 4k, SCRATCH_Y 0x20041000 4k, the 256-byte .boot2 first in FLASH, then the vectors

ST's stm32h753xx.h, cmsis-device-h7 commit 81db1ec63cdc191fae1565b772da3ea5aa29a683, SHA-256 4f6def439a9fa94705303fe227d34308048c44bd36263d311aa54cc94f8398f5: D1_AXIFLASH_BASE 0x08000000 to FLASH_END 0x081FFFFF, D1_ITCMRAM_BASE 0 64KB, D1_DTCMRAM_BASE 0x20000000 128KB, D1_AXISRAM_BASE 0x24000000 512KB, D2_AHBSRAM_BASE 0x30000000 288KB as SRAM1 128K, SRAM2 128K and SRAM3 32K, D3_SRAM_BASE 0x38000000 64 KB
sources.interrupts: the same header's IRQn_Type: external interrupts 0 to 149, and RM0433 Rev 9 Table 147, p. 759, which has WWDG1_RST at 143, where the header has none, and the RAMECC interrupt ECC at 145, which the SVD lacks and the policy adds (D560); USART3_IRQn 39
sources.core slots: ARMv7-M: MemManage 4, BusFault 5, UsageFault 6 and DebugMonitor 12 taken, 7 to 10 and 13 reserved

sources.profile: spec.md [1990]: 32 KiB flash at zero, 16 KiB RAM at 0x20000000, the upper 4 KiB the stack, a 48-word table at zero, core slots 4-10 and 12-13 and slots 21 and 42-47 zero
